notes.title: Abstractanoid is now released!
notes.content:
It has new things inside, such as:

[list]
[*] New enemies and levels (+ some were reworked)
[*] New bonuses
[*] Anti-bonuses (how do you name it correctly?)
[*] Level editor
[*] New music tracks
[*] A bunch of mechanics fixes
[*] Popping up tutorial on the first level
[*] Ball bounce direction prediction (sometimes wrong!)
[*] Parallax background new mode
[*] Deleted shiny space (it was extra shiny I had to remove it)
[*] Added shiny text messages (it looks cool you know)
[*] Umm... minor fixes!
[/list]

Thank you for being a part of Early Access!

katanadeath.

notes.title: Abstractanoid v0.5 is now avaliable!
notes.content:
... actually it was updated one week ago ...

The update contains:
[list]
[*] New shiny graphics (particle based, may reduce performance)
[*] Nice animated aliens' sprites
[*] Steam achievements
[*] 5 more levels!
[*] Minor bug fixes!
[/list]

Screenshots and trailer will be updated soon. ːcsdsmileː

P.S.: To disable shiny space, you have to go to options screen and click a "Nice space" checkbox.

notes.title: First hotfix is online!
notes.content:
Added [i]VSync[/i] option (it was enabled by default earlier).

[b]VERY IMPORTANT[/b]: If you are a Windows 10 Creators Update user, the game could be broken (black screen but game is running and music is playing).

To fix it:
[list]
    [*][i]Alt+Enter[/i]
    [*]Options
    [*]Enable VSync
    [*]Then go fullscreen (if you want to...)
[/list]

And also, now you can speed up gameplay by holding Space (when [i]VSync[/i] is disabled). If you're like "OMG the game is so slow!" - this feature is for you! ːgetdizzyː

Happy alien crushing!
